name: wideang-field-ramp-demo
description: Field ramp for a user-supplied wide-angle lens (semi-field 36 degrees, no vignetting, at least 12 surfaces) whose fields were first reduced to 0/12.6/18 degrees: two steps raise fields 2 and 3 to 20/28 and 25.2/36 degrees, each step optimizing from the previous step's candidate. All values are demonstration values; the point is the mechanism, not the design. AUT runs only with the real backend: adapt surface numbers and values to your own lens.
